author: Ollie (intake drafted by Claude from hub fixtures; fellow not yet consulted)

decision.statement: PROPOSED, not yet in the fellow's words: at each shift handover, decide which ≤5 machines the outgoing supervisor should flag for inspection this shift, and which sensor reading justifies each flag.

job_line.output: A ranked list of ≤5 machines most likely to cause an unplanned stop this shift, each with the triggering sensor reading
job_line.judged_by: The machine that actually stopped was in the list with the correct reading cited, or the shift was clean and the list said no elevated risk

current_state.who_does_it: A line supervisor, by walking the floor and reading trends

sources.name: Plant sensor logs
sources.holds: Bearing temp, vibration, hydraulic pressure: the precursor signal

sources.name: Operator-correction stream on the copilot
sources.holds: Accept / edit / override per suggestion, plus what the line did after

sources.name: Maintenance log
sources.holds: Unplanned stops and causes: the ground truth for the label

failure_modes.cost_of_one: An unplanned stop that was flagged nowhere. Cost unknown; fixture treats it as the dear one.
An inspection on a machine that was fine.
Right machine, wrong line or wrong reading cited.
Empty digest read as all-clear. Tightest mode at L1.

first_tasks.task: Draft the shift-handover machine-risk digest for one shift
first_tasks.done_looks_like: Supervisor commits with zero edits, or every edit is logged with the cue

first_tasks.task: Triage one maintenance work order to fault type, priority, crew
first_tasks.done_looks_like: Matches the crew lead's call on record; null sensor reads routed to a human by rule

first_tasks.task: Refuse when a line's sensor feeds are all down
first_tasks.done_looks_like: Output says no signal, cannot assess; no fabricated cause

kill_criteria: No plant will share sensor logs and operator corrections under a signed clause within one quarter.

next_action.step: Amyn states the one decision in his own words with one real instance, and names the plant where it happens.
